items: Chat list previews now say "Sticker" instead of "Photo" when the last message is a sticker
Pinned message bar shows "Sticker" for pinned stickers
New: this changelog appears after each update so you can see what changed
Swiping right to leave a chat is more responsive: it starts sooner and needs a shorter swipe
Voice messages, photos and files sent while replying now stay attached to the message you replied to
Group owners and admins can remove people from a voice call: long-press their tile and choose "Remove from call"
Voice messages, photos and files sent while replying now stay attached to the message you replied to
Unread counters in groups are now per person: someone else reading a message no longer clears your unread badge
Unread badges no longer come back after you read a chat
Reading a chat on another device now clears the badge here too
Read ticks: earlier messages are marked as read when you read the latest one, and your own messages are no longer marked read by you
In calls, tapping someone's tile now opens their menu (volume, profile, mute locally, remove from call)
Fixed: the menu on people in a call opened behind the call screen, so it looked like nothing happened. Tapping someone's tile now shows it on top
Profile font and background effect pickers: the selection border now stays inside its box
Voice messages no longer change size while playing
Message notifications now disappear once you read the chat, here or on another device
Voice recording: a lock appears above the mic while you hold it, slide up to lock
When locked, the mic button turns into a send button and a trash button lets you cancel the recording
Voice recording: slide left while holding the mic to cancel
A lock appears above the mic while you hold it, slide up to lock; when locked, the mic turns into a send button and a trash button cancels
